title: Dev3 qualification status and evidence boundary
summary: The 23 October dev3 archive reports a clean C11 build, 4 native hold tests, four WebM and two still assets staged, 392 file-output frames across four scenes with zero underruns and byte-exact I420/PCM, and strict ooRexx standards PASS with zero findings. This does not prove browser, device or WhatsApp operation.
invariants: Do not treat a historical dev2 live run as a dev3 live-host retest.
Keep each qualifier separate: source checks, simulated file output, ooRexx FFI, live V4L2, live microphone and end-to-end call.
A 'not tested' result must not be relabelled a PASS.
No accepted Autobuild receipt exists for the prior source submission as of the status check in this sphere; it is committed to an immutable submission branch, not main.
procedure: Rebuild in a clean environment and run python3 tests/test_native_hold.py.
Verify staged real assets using tests/verify_real_staged_native.py and compare file hashes and frame counts.
Run actual openSUSE Firefox and WhatsApp receiver-side test and record FPS, audio level, skew and device recovery.
Check Autobuild receipt and published package path before claiming main acceptance.

provenance.claim: Test status and explicit unqualified items.
392 frames, four scenes, byte-exact file-output evidence.
